diagnostic.description_commande: Check the server's settings and say what stops the bot from working properly
diagnostic.intro: What I can see for myself: permissions, channels, roles and intents. I don't fix anything, I only say what's wrong.
diagnostic.bloquant_titre: This stops a feature from working
diagnostic.sain_texte: No problem found: the permissions, channels and roles I need are all in place.
diagnostic.reste_texte: Nothing else to report: the rest of the permissions, channels, roles and intents are in order.
diagnostic.permissions_texte:
I'm missing {liste}. An administrator must have removed them after I joined, or my role is badly placed.
**What to do**: give them back in Server Settings → Roles, or re-invite me with the button below.
diagnostic.role_texte: My role is too low to hand out these roles (or they're managed by an integration):
diagnostic.role_raison_gere: managed by an integration, I'll never be able to give it
diagnostic.role_raison_position: too high — drag my role above it in Settings → Roles
diagnostic.salons_supprimes_texte: These settings point to a channel that no longer exists. Pick another one in `/config`, or clear the setting:
diagnostic.salons_illisibles_texte: These channels exist, but I'm no longer allowed to write in them. Give me back View Channel + Send Messages, or pick another one:
diagnostic.incomplet_titre: Half-finished settings — ready, but they'll never fire without the last piece:
diagnostic.incomplet_bienvenue: A welcome message is written, but no welcome channel is chosen: it will never be sent. Pick a channel in `/config`, Arrivals category.
diagnostic.incomplet_aurevoir: A goodbye message is written, but no channel is chosen: it will never be sent. Pick a channel in `/config`, Departures category.
diagnostic.incomplet_verification: Entry verification is on, but no role is given after validation: it turns everyone away. Pick a role in `/config`, Security category.
diagnostic.incomplet_appels: Sanction appeals are on, but no channel receives them: they stay stuck. Pick an appeals channel.
diagnostic.incomplet_candidatures: A staff role is set for applications, but no channel receives them: nobody can apply. Pick a channel in `/config`, Community category.
diagnostic.incomplet_suggestions: A staff role is set for suggestions, but no channel receives them: nobody can send one. Pick a channel in `/config`, Community category.
diagnostic.incomplet_tickets: A staff role is set for tickets, but no category is chosen: tickets will be created at the server root, unsorted. Pick a category in `/config`, Tickets category.
diagnostic.intents_texte: The application doesn't have access to {liste}. This isn't one of your server's settings: only the bot's owner can turn it on in the Developer Portal. In the meantime, some features you turned on run in degraded mode.

_note_permissions: Additions to the `permissions` namespace, already present in fr.json/en.json with only 7 of the 21 permissions from src/utils/liens.js. Completes rather than replaces: deep merge, never overwriting the 7 already there.
